plain: Pass external to a Button to show the external-link arrow; the external-link arrow on Button and InlineLink now eases up and right on hover and focus, and stays still under reduced motion.

steps.plain: styles.css no longer ships four group-hover and group-focus-visible translate utilities and transition-[translate], which only InlineLink's external icon used (hds#1530); if your markup writes one, compile it with your own Tailwind.
The Button demo gained two external-link buttons (the new external prop), each ending in a visually hidden "(opens in new tab)" span (hds#1537); a Button without external renders as before.
